instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: You should throw the ball using your ((shoulder)).
atoms.finishSound: You should throw the ball using your shoulder.

atoms.b: Please give your essays a ((thorough)) read through before submitting.
atoms.finishSound: Please give your essays a thorough read through before submitting.

atoms.b: Do you have time to ((accompany)) me to my doctor’s appointment?
atoms.finishSound: Do you have time to accompany me to my doctor’s appointment?

atoms.b: Paramedics respond to ((immediate)) calls for help.
atoms.finishSound: Paramedics respond to immediate calls for help.

atoms.b: There are lots of women in the ((committee)).
atoms.finishSound: There are lots of women in the committee.

atoms.b: You didn’t ((embarrass)) yourself with your performance.
atoms.finishSound: You didn’t embarrass yourself with your performance.
